verdict.rationale: AiPrise is an AI-powered compliance and KYC platform that processes sensitive identity data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage controls. The cited material covers only verification flows, screening, monitoring and team access management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
